F221.summary: Branded ID generation implemented with prefix + auto-increment, retries for constraint violations

Entity IDs use branded format (F###, P##.detail: getNextId queries MAX(id) in transaction, increments, pads to 3 digits. generateFeatureId->F prefix, generateProjectId->P, generateSessionId->S, generateLearningId->L. Retries on UNIQUE constraint violations.

All repositories use branded generation.detail: projectRepository.create, featureRepository.create, sessionRepository.create all use generateXId() from id-generation.ts when no explicit id provided.

F222.summary: bulkUpdateStatus now wrapped in transactions with validation

Transaction wraps validation + update.detail: bulkUpdateStatus uses db.transaction(). bulkUpdateStatusWithValidation also transactional — fetches, validates transitions, then updates atomically.

Projects table includes status column.detail: status: text('status').notNull().default('draft') in project table schema.

F224.summary: userId columns present and ownership enforced in all router handlers

userId columns added.detail: userId: text('user_id').notNull() in project, feature, agentSession, learning tables.

Ownership enforced in routes.detail: All protectedProcedure handlers check context.session.user.id. project.get checks project.userId !== context.session.user.id. feature.get/update/delete check feat.userId. Throws FORBIDDEN on mismatch.

F225.summary: Rate limiting implemented as in-memory middleware

Rate limiting on routes.detail: In-memory rate limiter in apps/server/src/index.ts. 100 requests/minute per IP. Returns 429 with Retry-After header.

F226.summary: SDK client has error classification, retry with exponential backoff, and connection timeout

Error handling and retry logic.detail: classifyError categorizes 7 error types. MAX_RETRIES=3 with exponential backoff + jitter. CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS=300s.

F227.summary: Agent service has input validation and resource limits

Input validation and limits.detail: MAX_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS=5, MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH=100KB, MAX_SESSION_NAME_LENGTH=200. Input validated via Zod in session router.

F228.summary: Streaming implementation exists via ClaudeProvider AsyncGenerator

Streaming implementation exists.detail: ClaudeProvider.executeQuery returns AsyncGenerator<ProviderMessage>. Streams text, tool calls, thinking tokens in real-time.

Rollback mechanism exists.detail: backupDatabase() creates .bak before migrations. rollbackDatabase() restores from .bak. Both exported from db package.

F230.summary: TypeScript project references working via composite flag and shared config

TypeScript project references configured.detail: packages/types/tsconfig.json has composite: true, declaration: true, declarationMap: true. Extends @nomos-ai/config/tsconfig.base.json. Standard TS project reference pattern.
